verdict.rationale: Docs show Copilot agent mode can edit files, work autonomously in background, and the coding agent workflow explicitly includes review changes and merge completed work, plus a control plane to track/manage agent sessions, implying PR-centric workflows; GitHub's coding agent is well-known to open PRs but this pack lacks explicit doc text naming 'stage changes,' 'write commit messages,' 'create branches,' or 'open pull requests' verbatim. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/citation of commit message generation, branch creation, and PR-opening steps, plus independent hands-on confirmation of this exact workflow.
